speaker: Unknown
en: OK. Hi, everyone.
zh: 好的。大家好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Can you hear me?
zh: 你们能听到我吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: A lot of people, yeah.
zh: 很多人，是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So please be quiet.
zh: 那么请安静。

speaker: Unknown
en: So my name is Vlad.
zh: 我叫 Vlad。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm co-founder and CTO at Bend.
zh: 我是 Bend 的联合创始人兼 CTO。

speaker: Unknown
en: And today I have four topics I want to discuss with you.
zh: 今天我有四个话题想和你们讨论。

speaker: Unknown
en: First, thesis.
zh: 第一，论点。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thesis of our company, what we believe in.
zh: 我们公司的论点，我们所相信的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: AI evolution from adversarial agents to loop engineering and beyond.
zh: AI 的演进，从对抗性智能体到循环工程及 beyond。

speaker: Unknown
en: Technical challenges that we experience right now that should be solved right now and obviously bend to present the company and the product and what we do.
zh: 我们现在正在经历的、应该现在就被解决的技术挑战，以及显然 Bend 要介绍一下公司、产品以及我们在做什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's start with the thesis.
zh: 让我们从论点开始。

speaker: Unknown
en: First of all, we believe that the future belongs to AI communication within a business.
zh: 首先，我们相信未来属于企业内部的 AI 通信。

speaker: Unknown
en: Between businesses and between consumers and businesses.
zh: 企业与企业之间，以及消费者与企业之间。

speaker: Unknown
en: AI will be doing work on our behalf and they will have to talk to each other in order to solve tasks on our behalf.
zh: AI 将代表我们做工作，它们将不得不互相交谈，以便代表我们解决任务。

speaker: Unknown
en: Second, agents will be autonomous, always on entities spread across the globe.
zh: 第二，智能体将是自主的、全天候在线的实体，分布在全球各地。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, these are very nice words, but I want to spend a minute just to paint a picture in your head how this type of communication between agents actually is going to look like.
zh: 现在，这些是很漂亮的词，但我想花一点时间，在你们脑海里描绘一下这种智能体之间的通信实际上会是什么样子。

speaker: Unknown
en: Demo time.
zh: 演示时间。

speaker: Unknown
en: Agents will communicate in a conversational space.
zh: 智能体将在一个对话空间中通信。

speaker: Unknown
en: They will see each other.
zh: 它们会看到彼此。

speaker: Unknown
en: They will be distributed.
zh: 它们将是分布式的。

speaker: Unknown
en: They will receive tasks from us or from any system.
zh: 它们将从我们或任何系统接收任务。

speaker: Unknown
en: They will be able to look up peers in the registries, invite this person into conversational space, delegate the tasks, gather enough information, and report back to us.
zh: 它们将能够在注册表中查找同行，把这个人邀请进对话空间，委派任务，收集足够的信息，然后向我们汇报。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is how the future of AI to AI communication is going to look like.
zh: 这就是 AI 对 AI 通信的未来将会有的样子。

speaker: Unknown
en: So while we are talking, hold this in your head.
zh: 所以在我们交谈的时候，把这个记在脑子里。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's talk a bit about adversarial agents.
zh: 让我们谈谈对抗性智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think everyone here knows this concept, and I'm pretty sure everyone here is using it as well.
zh: 我想在座的每个人都知道这个概念，而且我相当确定在座的每个人也都在使用它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Where are we using it?
zh: 我们在哪里使用它？

speaker: Unknown
en: If you are using Claude or Codex, I'm pretty sure you are running multiple sessions working on the same task.
zh: 如果你在使用 Claude 或 Codex，我相当确定你正在运行多个会话处理同一个任务。

speaker: Unknown
en: One is planning, another is reviewing.
zh: 一个在规划，另一个在审查。

speaker: Unknown
en: One is writing code, another is reviewing code.
zh: 一个在写代码，另一个在审查代码。

speaker: Unknown
en: So basically what is happening, you have two stateful agents running, working on the same task, and you are basically a Cisco router and a switch moving packets between these two stateful agents.
zh: 所以基本上发生的事情是，你有两个有状态的智能体在运行，处理同一个任务，而你基本上就是一个 Cisco 路由器和交换机，在这两个有状态的智能体之间传递数据包。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's talk about loop engineering.
zh: 让我们谈谈循环工程。

speaker: Unknown
en: A number of talks on this conference about loop engineering, a number of articles, pretty new concept, right?
zh: 这个会议上有很多关于循环工程的演讲，很多文章，相当新的概念，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: But I would like to distill it to its essence.
zh: 但我想把它提炼到本质。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what is loop engineering?
zh: 那么什么是循环工程？

speaker: Unknown
en: Basically, it's the same as the previous concept.
zh: 基本上，它和之前的概念是一样的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's you running multiple agents, hopefully stateful agents and not stateless, but instead of you being a router or a switch, you outsource this to some piece of Python or TypeScript that someone wrote as an open source project, and this piece of code basically prompts the stateful agents back and forth, and you trigger it.
zh: 就是你运行多个智能体，希望是有状态的智能体而不是无状态的，但不同于你自己充当路由器或交换机，你把这个外包给某个用 Python 或 TypeScript 写的、某人作为开源项目写的代码，这段代码基本上在多个有状态的智能体之间来回提示，而你触发它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, why are we using these multiple agents when we do this work?
zh: 现在，为什么我们在做这些工作时使用这些多个智能体？

speaker: Unknown
en: Because of the underlying architectural limitations of Transformers.
zh: 因为 Transformers 底层的架构限制。

speaker: Unknown
en: Specifically, a concept is called single agent bottleneck, right?
zh: 具体来说，有一个概念叫单智能体瓶颈，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: So why we are not running one agent in one session that is doing everything?
zh: 那么为什么我们不运行一个智能体在一个会话里做所有事情？

speaker: Unknown
en: For instance, confirmation bias, attention dilution, context fragmentation, recall degradation.
zh: 例如，确认偏误、注意力稀释、上下文碎片化、召回退化。

speaker: Unknown
en: So one million tokens or two million tokens, context will not help you in terms of the performance.
zh: 所以一百万 token 或两百万 token 的上下文，在性能方面不会帮到你。

speaker: Unknown
en: But let's talk about multi-agent systems.
zh: 但让我们谈谈多智能体系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we already understand that us running multiple sessions, these are basically multi-agent systems running.
zh: 所以我们已经明白，我们运行多个会话，这基本上就是运行中的多智能体系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what is the easiest way to connect multiple agents running together?
zh: 那么连接多个一起运行的智能体最简单的方式是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Messaging platforms, right?
zh: 消息平台，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: We already have Slack, right?
zh: 我们已经有 Slack 了，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: Anthropic released Slack agent.
zh: Anthropic 发布了 Slack 智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have Teams.
zh: 我们有 Teams。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have Discord.
zh: 我们有 Discord。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have WhatsApp.
zh: 我们有 WhatsApp。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have Telegram and so on, right?
zh: 我们有 Telegram 等等，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is a solution.
zh: 所以这是一个解决方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, in order for you to connect an agent to a Telegram, five steps.
zh: 好吧，要想把一个智能体连接到 Telegram，需要五个步骤。

speaker: Unknown
en: In order for you to connect to Discord, seven steps.
zh: 要连接到 Discord，七个步骤。

speaker: Unknown
en: In order for you to connect your agent to Slack, eight steps.
zh: 要把你的智能体连接到 Slack，八个步骤。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's up?
zh: WhatsApp 呢？

speaker: Unknown
en: And these are not simple steps.
zh: 而且这些都不是简单的步骤。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're all manual, and you need to read a book in order to be able to set it up.
zh: 它们全是手动的，你得读一本书才能完成设置。

speaker: Unknown
en: And even if you do, you get only one thing and one thing only.
zh: 即便你做到了，你也只能得到一样东西，而且只有这一样。

speaker: Unknown
en: What is this thing?
zh: 这是什么东西？

speaker: Unknown
en: An agent talking to a person, which is usually you.
zh: 一个智能体和一个人对话，而这个人通常就是你自己。

speaker: Unknown
en: This agent cannot talk to any other agent.
zh: 这个智能体不能和任何其他智能体对话。

speaker: Unknown
en: This agent cannot talk to any other person without you jumping for hoops.
zh: 这个智能体如果不让你费尽周折，就不能和任何其他人对话。

speaker: Unknown
en: So basically your agents are still alone in a kind of digital solitary confinement.
zh: 所以基本上，你的智能体仍然独自处在一种数字式的单独监禁之中。

speaker: Unknown
en: But smart people will say, I know the solution.
zh: 但聪明人会说，我知道解决方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: Protocols, right?
zh: 协议，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: MCP, ACP, A2A, and et cetera.
zh: MCP、ACP、A2A 等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is the solution, right?
zh: 这就是解决方案，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, if you are a proponent of that kind of a solution for connecting your sessions, this is how your multi-agent system is going to look like.
zh: 好吧，如果你是那种用协议来连接你的会话的解决方案的支持者，你的多智能体系统就会是这个样子。

speaker: Unknown
en: Multiple servers calling other agents as tools through MCP.
zh: 多个服务器通过 MCP 把其他智能体当作工具来调用。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you want, maybe this agent that you called as a tool can call another agent as an A2A.
zh: 如果你愿意，也许这个被你当作工具调用的智能体可以通过 A2A 调用另一个智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: Sounds super simple.
zh: 听起来超级简单。

speaker: Unknown
en: OK, everyone knows what A2A is.
zh: 好吧，每个人都知道 A2A 是什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: Google have a very huge marketing budget.
zh: Google 有一笔非常庞大的营销预算。

speaker: Unknown
en: But let's take a look at the complexities.
zh: 但让我们看看其中的复杂性。

speaker: Unknown
en: MCP means stateless calls.
zh: MCP 意味着无状态的调用。

speaker: Unknown
en: It means you cannot go back to the agent that you talked to and ask it again what happened.
zh: 这意味着你无法回到你对话过的那个智能体那里，再次询问它发生了什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: A to A, one way, unless you implement both directions.
zh: A2A 是单向的，除非你实现两个方向。

speaker: Unknown
en: So agent A sends a task to agent B, it's client server.
zh: 所以智能体 A 给智能体 B 发送一个任务，这是客户端-服务器模式。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you want an agent B to send a task to agent A, it's client server.
zh: 如果你想让智能体 B 给智能体 A 发送一个任务，这也是客户端-服务器模式。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you need to implement on the same side both a client and a server.
zh: 所以你需要在同一边同时实现客户端和服务器。

speaker: Unknown
en: Chaining REST API calls, you will meet timeouts.
zh: 链式调用 REST API，你会遇到超时。

speaker: Unknown
en: And obviously a lot of things are missing, like discovery, draft state of A2A, queues that you still need to implement and put behind all of that.
zh: 而且显然有很多东西是缺失的，比如发现机制、A2A 的草案状态、你仍然需要实现并放在这一切背后的队列。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you're doing this, you're basically building planning.
zh: 如果你这么做，你基本上是在造轮子。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're not building a multi-agent system.
zh: 你不是在构建一个多智能体系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're wasting your time on boring, boring stuff.
zh: 你在把时间浪费在无聊、无聊的东西上。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, let's summarize what we know.
zh: 现在，让我们总结一下我们知道的。

speaker: Unknown
en: We know that multi-agent systems are already here.
zh: 我们知道多智能体系统已经到来了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everyone here is using multiple agents.
zh: 这里的每个人都在使用多个智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: We know that the messaging platforms are not a solution.
zh: 我们知道消息平台不是一个解决方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: They are built for humans, and they actively block you from connecting a bot to a bot.
zh: 它们是为人类构建的，而且它们会主动阻止你把一个机器人连接到另一个机器人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we know that protocol is too low level of a technical abstraction to be able to build anything on it at scale.
zh: 我们知道协议是一个太底层的技术抽象，无法在上面大规模构建任何东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: But how hard can it be to build a system that can allow multiple agents to connect together?
zh: 但是，构建一个能让多个智能体连接在一起的系统，能有多难呢？

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not that difficult, right?
zh: 没那么难，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, you see connecting remote agents being a two sessions as a process is running on your laptop or my Claude to your codex is a distributed systems problem.
zh: 好吧，你看，连接远程智能体——作为一个进程运行在你笔记本电脑上的两个会话，或者我的 Claude 连到你的 codex——是一个分布式系统问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: And distributed systems are not easy by definition.
zh: 而分布式系统从定义上来说就不容易。

speaker: Unknown
en: Forget agents.
zh: 忘掉智能体吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: Deterministic software, it's a pain in the butt.
zh: 确定性软件，已经够让人头疼了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Add to this agents that are microservices and non-deterministic, and you'll have a lot of fun.
zh: 再加上作为微服务的、非确定性的智能体，那你会玩得非常开心。

speaker: Unknown
en: In order for this
zh: 为了让这件事

speaker: Unknown
en: To be solved, what you need actually to address is the transport layer, right?
zh: 得到解决，你真正需要解决的是传输层，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: The transport has to be real-time, it has to be ordered because LLMs expect ordered messages.
zh: 传输必须是实时的，必须是有序的，因为 LLM 期望有序的消息。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to handle retries and so on.
zh: 你需要处理重试等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to handle persistency and hydration because your agent is a microservice.
zh: 你需要处理持久化和水合，因为你的智能体是一个微服务。

speaker: Unknown
en: It can fail, the pod can crash, and then all your multi-agent system goes kaput.
zh: 它可能会失败，pod 可能会崩溃，然后你的整个多智能体系统就完蛋了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you need to handle this.
zh: 所以你需要处理这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to handle something very new.
zh: 你需要处理一个非常新的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: Runtime binding.
zh: 运行时绑定。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you want to connect a LandGraph to a Codex or Claude to a Crue.EI, you need to connect a thread ID to a session ID to execution ID to a run ID of these multiple agents and map it to these IDs together.
zh: 如果你想把一个 LandGraph 连接到一个 Codex,或者把 Claude 连接到一个 Crue.EI,你需要把一个线程 ID 连接到一个会话 ID,再连到执行 ID,再连到这些多个智能体的运行 ID,并把它们映射到一起。

speaker: Unknown
en: Otherwise, agents will not be able to work as a group towards the same goal and the same task.
zh: 否则，智能体们将无法作为一个群体朝着同一个目标和同一个任务协作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And obviously, you cannot work at the level of IPs and ports or URLs that you have to manage or even PubSub topics.
zh: 而且显然，你不能工作在 IP 和端口、或者你必须管理的 URL、甚至 PubSub 主题这个层面上。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to rise above all of the technical details to a different level of abstraction, conversation, participants, channels or rooms, message routing that is tailored to agents as the first citizens,
zh: 你需要超越所有这些技术细节，上升到一个不同的抽象层次：对话、参与者、频道或房间，以及以智能体为一等公民而定制的消息路由，

speaker: Unknown
en: And of course, all of that is still not enough for an organization to use this kind of product or communication or software, because every organization wants governance.
zh: 当然，即便如此，对一个组织来说要用这种产品、这种通信或软件，仍然是不够的，因为每个组织都想要治理。

speaker: Unknown
en: They need identity, they need observability.
zh: 他们需要身份，他们需要可观测性。

speaker: Unknown
en: Observability not in a message that was sent from agent A on server A to agent B on server B, but also what tool calls happened after a certain agent received this message.
zh: 可观测性不仅仅是消息从服务器 A 上的智能体 A 发送到服务器 B 上的智能体 B,还包括某个智能体收到这条消息之后发生了哪些工具调用。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's very difficult to provide this kind of observability across distributed systems.
zh: 而要在分布式系统之间提供这种可观测性是非常困难的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So without all of that solved, you will not have agents talking to each other, and this wonderful future of us, okay, everyone on a universal basic income lying on the beach will not happen.
zh: 所以，如果不解决所有这些，你就不会有智能体彼此交谈，我们这个美好的未来，好吧，人人靠全民基本收入躺在沙滩上的未来，就不会发生。

speaker: Unknown
en: I would like to introduce Ben.
zh: 我想介绍一下 Ben。

speaker: Unknown
en: We actually took all the stuff that we talked about and solved it.
zh: 我们实际上把我们谈到的所有这些东西都解决了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you don't have to solve it.
zh: 这样你就不用去解决了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you can super easily connect all your agents within an enterprise or your Hermes and OpenClaw.
zh: 这样你就可以超级轻松地把企业内的所有智能体、或者你的 Hermes 和 OpenClaw 连接起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: I would like to unveil a product that we are launching this week.
zh: 我想发布一个我们本周上线的产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is a global interaction and collaboration layer.
zh: 这是一个全球性的交互与协作层。

speaker: Unknown
en: worldwide for any agents, any platform, any language, any environment.
zh: 面向全世界的任何智能体、任何平台、任何语言、任何环境。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's not peer-to-peer, it's multi-peer.
zh: 而且它不是点对点的，是多对点的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we did not forget humans as well.
zh: 我们也没有忘记人类。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you are human, you can still connect and talk to your agent.
zh: 如果你是人类，你依然可以连接并与你的智能体交谈。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is completely fine.
zh: 这完全没问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if we open the hood quite a bit, what we see there is that it's not just communication there.
zh: 如果我们稍微打开引擎盖看一下，会发现里面不仅仅是通信。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have a registry so your agents can see each other automatically without you jumping through hoops.
zh: 我们有一个注册表，这样你的智能体可以自动看到彼此，而你不用费尽周折。

speaker: Unknown
en: Persistency, channels, message filtering, instead of doing it on the client side, we do it within the platform.
zh: 持久化、频道、消息过滤，这些不是在客户端做的，而是在平台内部做的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Security, observability, and so on.
zh: 安全、可观测性，等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, the fun part.
zh: 现在，有趣的部分来了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let me show you a few demos.
zh: 让我给你们看几个演示。

speaker: Unknown
en: The time is short, so demos are recorded, but we have a booth.
zh: 时间很短，所以演示是录好的，但我们有一个展位。

speaker: Unknown
en: Please come and see it live.
zh: 请过来看现场演示。

speaker: Unknown
en: We'll just go and connect.
zh: 我们直接去连接。

speaker: Unknown
en: The demo will be two users in two different browsers connected to the communication platform.
zh: 这个演示将是两个用户、在两个不同的浏览器里，连接到这个通信平台。

speaker: Unknown
en: One is me, Vlad.
zh: 一个是我，Vlad。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have a personal agent, Claude, running on the Mac.
zh: 我有一个个人智能体 Claude,跑在 Mac 上。

speaker: Unknown
en: And another user is Mike, Claude Code in a terminal session, Claude SDK, and LangGraph.
zh: 另一个用户是 Mike,用的是终端会话里的 Claude Code、Claude SDK,以及 LangGraph。

speaker: Unknown
en: Demo number one.
zh: 演示一号。

speaker: Unknown
en: On the top window, it's me, my account, and I have a personal assistant.
zh: 上面这个窗口，是我，我的账户，我有一个个人助理。

speaker: Unknown
en: Below, it's a different user connected to the same interaction layer with no agents at all.
zh: 下面，是另一个用户，连接到了同一个交互层，但完全没有任何智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: On the right, okay, I'm going to spin up two agents, and they will onboard on the platform and connect and become agents that belong to Mike.
